mapper.sql: id, task_id, robot_id, robot_name, time, equity, return_rate, drawdown, benchmark_value, benchmark_return_rate
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO ai_equity_curve (task_id, robot_id, robot_name, time, equity, return_rate, drawdown, benchmark_value, benchmark_return_rate) VALUES
(#{item.taskId}, #{item.robotId}, #{item.robotName}, #{item.time}, #{item.equity}, #{item.returnRate}, #{item.drawdown}, #{item.benchmarkValue}, #{item.benchmarkReturnRate})

INSERT INTO ai_equity_curve (task_id, robot_id, robot_name, time, equity, return_rate, drawdown) VALUES
(#{item.taskId}, #{item.robotId}, #{item.robotName}, #{item.time}, #{item.equity}, #{item.returnRate}, #{item.drawdown})
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE equity = VALUES(equity), return_rate = VALUES(return_rate), drawdown = VALUES(drawdown)
mapper.select: SELECT DATE(time) AS date, SUM(equity) AS total_equity FROM ai_equity_curve WHERE robot_id IS NOT NULL AND task_id IS NULL AND time BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} GROUP BY DATE(time) ORDER BY date ASC
